candidates.title: Make the language picker and the four accordion headers real buttons
candidates.rationale: They are clickable <div>s, so keyboard users cannot open them. Real buttons take focus and announce their expanded state.

candidates.title: Make “Ready to apply?” a level-2 heading
candidates.rationale: The Apply button sits at the bottom of a long page. A real heading above it lets screen-reader users jump straight to the application.

candidates.title: Add a “Skip to main content” link
candidates.rationale: Twelve header and navigation stops come before the first sentence of content.
